thread:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary deploy 2024-11-12T16:13Z -> service=runtime; errors=5xx(3x baseline); action=auto-rollback-initiated :rotating_light:

maria: Confirmed. Canary shows spike in DB conn timeouts and KV cache misses. I'm paged.

dan: Oncall takeover. What's the rollback plan? Manual or let auto-rollback proceed?

maria: Auto-rollback already started but some replicas hung during drain. We need a manual unwind for traffic pinned to canary nodes.

jess: Noted. I'm pulling up the drain logs. If we flip feature flag, traffic will re-route to stable. Recommend: flag flip + drain kill-switch.

oncall: I'll hold traffic and run smoke. Maria, can you pin the kill-switch flag? /feature-flags flip runtime.canary_active false

maria: Flipped the flag -> runtime.canary_active=false :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: [INFO] Traffic shift started -> 80% -> 20% canary

dan: Running quick smoke: GET /health on stable endpoints -> 200/OK. No obvious regressions.

jess: Drain command results (tail):
```
node-42: draining connections... stuck on 1 conn for 2m
node-43: drained
node-44: error: db connection leak detected: socket timeout
```

maria: Node-42 needs forced-evict. I'm issuing: /infra evict node-42 force

infra: Eviction scheduled for node-42. Estimated cutoff 30s.

maria: Evicted node-42 and node-44. Canary instances gone. Confirming traffic now on stable.

deploy-bot: [INFO] Rollback complete. Canary variant removed from routing.

dan: Monitor CPU/latency for 10m. If no regressions, we'll mark resolved. Also open a postmortem ticket.

oncall: Customer impact: small percentage of requests got 503 for ~3 minutes, predominately in EU region. CS notified and we queued messages for impacted customers.

jess: Added note: root cause likely a driver upgrade in canary that increases connection churn under specific KV miss pattern. Will reproduce in staging.

maria: Handing off to next on-call (sam). Sam — see thread for actions taken. :arrow_right:

pagerduty-bot: Incident #INC-2024-892 created and assigned to sam.

dan: Closing out here. Follow-up actions: revert driver change from canary branch, add drain timeout backstop, add smoke test for DB conn churn. I'll draft the rollback runbook update.

maria: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
